title: 第004章 破格收录入仙门，一曲弦音解沉疴
content_zh:
村口空地死寂一瞬，随后压抑的议论声如同潮水般再度翻涌。

    在场的凡人村民依旧一头雾水，他们看不见无形的音律灵气，只瞧见测灵玉牌漆黑无光。

    便一致认定蔡小姬就是实打实的废柴。

    可两名清风宗外门弟子的反应，却让所有人心里打起了鼓。

    方才还满脸不耐、挥挥手就要将人赶走的两位修士，此刻双目圆睁，呼吸都变得急促起来！

    他俩的目光死死黏在蔡文姬身上，上下反复打量，眼神里的轻视荡然无存，取而代之的是浓烈的惊疑与探究。

    “李师兄，你方才……也感受到了吧？”

    个子稍矮的修士压低声音，语气里满是不敢置信，悄悄扯了扯身旁同伴的衣袖。

    被称作李师兄的青年缓缓点头，神色凝重：

    “千真万确。那股灵气温润至极，能安抚心神、修复暗伤，绝非五行灵根所能催生。是异灵根，而且是极为罕见的音律灵根！”

    青云修真界广袤无垠，灵根种类繁多。

    世人熟知金木水火土五行灵根，也有雷、风、冰等变异灵根，可音律灵根属于偏门至极的特殊道体。

    这类灵根不擅正面搏杀，战力看似羸弱，却拥有安神、疗愈、净化、控场等诸多妙用，越是高阶，越是弥足珍贵。

    尤其对于宗门而言，一名音律修士，足以安抚宗门弟子心魔、治愈修炼暗疾、辅助大型团战，价值远超寻常杂灵根修士。

    两人混迹清风宗多年，也是头一回遇见纯正的音律灵根。

    二人无从知晓，这份特殊音律本源，便是蔡文姬穿越后融于骨肉的胡笳琴所化仙骨。

    一旁围观的村民还在絮絮叨叨地嘲讽。

    “搞什么名堂？玉牌都不亮，两个仙长怎么还盯着她看？”

    “难不成这丫头耍了什么鬼把戏？”

    “依我看就是故弄玄虚，一个连灵气都引不动的废物，还能成气候？”

    王桂香抱着胳膊，嘴角挂着刻薄的笑，阴阳怪气地开口：

    “两位仙长，你们可别被这死丫头骗了！她打小就是个灾星，灵根碎得一塌糊涂，村里老人都瞧过，这辈子都别想修仙，纯粹是来捣乱的！”

    堂哥蔡文龙也上前一步，摆出一副明事理的模样：

    “仙长明鉴，她是我堂妹，天生体弱，脑子也不太灵光，怕是惊扰到二位了。不如就让她回去吧，别耽误了后续的选拔。”

    在他们看来，蔡小姬就是痴心妄想，如今见仙长神色异样，只当对方是被这丫头的小动作迷惑，一心想把人赶紧撵走，免得继续丢蔡家的脸面。
content_en:
The open space at the entrance of the village was silent for a moment, and then the suppressed discussion surged up again like a tide.

    The mortal villagers present were still confused. They could not see the invisible aura of music, they could only see the darkness of the spirit-detecting jade card.

    They all agreed that Cai Xiaoji was a real loser.

    But the reaction of the two Qingfeng Sect outer disciples made everyone feel excited.

    The two monks who had looked impatient just now and waved their hands to drive people away now had their eyes wide open and their breathing became rapid!

    Their eyes were glued to Cai Wenji, looking up and down repeatedly. The contempt in their eyes disappeared, replaced by strong suspicion and inquiry.

    "Senior Brother Li, you just... felt it too, right?"

    The shorter monk lowered his voice, his tone full of disbelief, and quietly tugged on the sleeves of his companion beside him.

    The young man known as Senior Brother Li nodded slowly with a solemn expression:

    "It's absolutely true. That spiritual energy is extremely moist and can soothe the mind and repair hidden wounds. It cannot be spawned by the Five Elements Spiritual Roots. It is a strange spiritual root, and it is an extremely rare musical root!"

    Qingyun's cultivation world is vast and has many types of spiritual roots.

    The world is familiar with the five elements spiritual roots of metal, wood, water, fire, and earth, and there are also mutant spiritual roots such as thunder, wind, and ice, but the musical root is a special Taoist body that is extremely partial.

    This type of spiritual root is not good at frontal combat, and its combat power may seem weak, but it has many wonderful functions such as calming the mind, healing, purifying, and controlling the field. The higher the level, the more precious it is.

    Especially for the sect, a music monk is enough to appease the inner demons of the sect disciples, cure hidden diseases, and assist in large-scale team battles. Its value is far beyond that of ordinary spiritual root monks.

    The two of them had been in the Qingfeng Sect for many years, and this was the first time they met the pure musical root.

    The two of them had no way of knowing that the origin of this special melody was the fairy bone transformed from the Hujia Qin that Cai Wenji had merged with her flesh and blood after traveling through time.

    The villagers watching on the sidelines were still chattering and mocking.

    "What's the trick? Why are the two immortals still staring at her when the jade medal is not even showing?"

    "Is it possible that this girl is playing some trick?"

    "In my opinion, it's just a mystery. How can a waste that can't even attract spiritual energy be successful?"

    Wang Guixiang crossed her arms, with a mean smile on her lips, and spoke in a sinister tone:

    "Two Immortal Leaders, don't be deceived by this damn girl! She has been a disaster since she was a child. Her spiritual roots were shattered into pieces. Even the elders in the village have seen it. Don't even think about cultivating immortals in this life. She is just here to cause trouble!"

    Cousin Cai Wenlong also took a step forward and put on a sensible look:

    "Xian Chang Mingjian, she is my cousin. She is born with a weak body and is not very bright. I am afraid she will disturb you two. Why don't we let her go back, so as not to delay the subsequent selection."

    In their opinion, Cai Xiaoji was just wishful thinking. Now that the immortal looked strange, they thought that he was confused by this girl's little actions and wanted to drive her away quickly to avoid further embarrassing the Cai family.
title_en: Chapter 004 Exceptionally included in the Immortal Sect, a piece of string music can relieve chronic illness
